chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him),
Which thing was the place of the House (Ka'ba) when the water was [there], in the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And His Throne was upon the water' [11:7]?
He said: 'It was a white Mahaat, meaning a gem (pearl).'

key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the House -- refers to the Ka'ba in Mecca, the most sacred site in Islam
key_terms.عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ: His Throne upon the water -- a Quranic reference (11:7) to the primordial state before creation
key_terms.مَهَاةً: Mahaat -- a specific term for a large white gem or pearl, used here to describe the primordial substance at the site of the Ka'ba

ai.seo_question: What was at the location of the Ka'ba when Allah's throne was upon the water according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Muhammad ibn Imran al-Ijali asks Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) about the primordial state of the Ka'ba's location before creation, referencing the Quranic verse 11:7 which describes Allah's throne being upon water. The Imam reveals that the site of the sacred House was at that time a white Mahaat -- a luminous pearl or gemstone. This hadith belongs to a series of narrations about the cosmological origins of the Ka'ba, conveying that its site was not merely empty water but a sacred, luminous substance from the beginning of creation.
